summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K Item 8.01 to announce the purchase of 1,109 bitcoin for ~$76,989 each (total ~$85.4M) and updates to its cash, bitcoin holdings, STRC stock, and share counts. It also flagged a potential near-term refresh of its ATM programs on Class A common and SATA preferred stock. No M&A, activist, or strategic review is disclosed. This is routine treasury management akin to a periodic bitcoin acquisition disclosure, not a special situation event. Watch for ATM execution and impact on share count/dilution.
